title: Remove duplicates with DISTINCT
description: Write a query that returns every distinct `country` value from the `customers` table, with no repeats.
hints: SELECT DISTINCT column collapses duplicate values in the result down to one copy each - it applies after the column is picked, before the rows are returned.
expected_behavior: Returns each distinct country value once.
explanation: DISTINCT removes duplicate rows from the final result set - with a single column selected, that means each value appears at most once.
